_doc: The chapter's recurring annual rhythm. The legacy site scattered these across six pages that contradicted each other, while shipping a live calendar grid with zero events in it. Here the meeting details exist exactly once.

meeting.monthsNote: Nine meetings a year — none in July or August

venue.name: American Legion Post 177
venue.mapQuery: American Legion Post 177, 3939 Oak St, Fairfax, VA

meeting.welcome: Anyone is welcome, including spouses and guests. You do not have to be a member to come to a meeting.
meeting.review: The legacy site says both “9 general meetings every Thursday evening except July, August and Christmas” and “the 3rd Thursday of almost every month”. Third Thursday is shown here because it appears in the membership letter and matches a nine-meeting year, but the chapter must confirm the day, the start time, and whether December has a meeting, a party, or both.

annual.title: Annual meeting
annual.description: Officers and directors are elected, as required by the chapter by-laws.

annual.title: Memorial Day observance
annual.description: Brunch, building a commemorative wreath, and gathering at the Vietnam Veterans Memorial with other veterans groups, followed by a potluck dinner at a member's home.

annual.title: Annual awards banquet
annual.description: The chapter recognizes members and partners.

annual.title: Chapter picnic
annual.description: A family gathering in the summer break between meetings.

annual.title: Anniversary dinner
annual.description: The October meeting is the chapter's birthday. The 39th anniversary dinner in 2024 featured a free buffet and a retired four-star general as speaker.

annual.title: Veterans Day observance
annual.description: The chapter gathers with other veterans organizations to mark the day.

annual.title: Holiday party
annual.description: Decorated and hosted by the chapter's AVVA members.
annual.review: The legacy site has an empty page titled “Christmas Party”. Details needed.

outreach.title: Mission BBQ veteran days
outreach.description: Chapter teams staff four Mission BBQ restaurants on days when the restaurant gives veterans a free sandwich.
outreach.review: The legacy site never names which four locations.

outreach.title: Tank Farm open house
outreach.description: The chapter exhibits at the National Museum of Americans in Wartime annual open house — more than 150 combat vehicles and around 20,000 visitors over two days.
outreach.review: No date or link for the next open house is published.
